metadata.title: Rustic Braided Portrait in Autumnal Field

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, rear-view medium shot of a person with blonde hair in a thick French braid, wearing a heavy wool plaid coat in burnt orange and charcoal, set against a desaturated, out-of-focus forest in late autumn.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical line of the braid bisects the frame, creating a strong central axis.
The warm, saturated tones of the coat contrast with the cool, muted grays of the background.
The sharp texture of the hair and wool fabric stands out against the soft bokeh of the trees.
coreInvariants: Single French braid as the central focal point
Overcast, natural lighting with no harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The nape of the neck where the braid begins to hang freely.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the braid from the top of the head down to the tip, then expands to the shoulders and the horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper third consisting of blurred tree branches and a pale sky.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted charcoal and earthy browns in the coat and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Burnt orange and rust tones in the plaid pattern.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value contrast between the dark coat and the light sky.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph from behind a person with a single long French braid. The person wears a thick, textured wool coat with a large plaid pattern in rust, orange, and black. The setting is a field in late autumn with bare, blurred trees in the background under a gray, overcast sky. The focus must be sharp on the hair texture and coat fibers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, serif typeface with wide tracking, placed in the upper third of the image in a muted white or light gray to maintain the somber, folk-inspired mood.

verificationChecks: Is the subject facing away from the camera?
Are the colors muted and autumnal?

adjustableVariables: Warmth of the blonde hair tones

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the hair and wool

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the braid looks natural and not overly symmetrical.
Check that the coat collar frames the neck realistically.
Verify the color palette remains within earthy, desaturated bounds.
Confirm the square composition is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rear-view portrait + centered French braid + heavy wool plaid coat + desaturated autumn forest background + shallow depth of field + film grain.
